{{Top|leg}}
'''Unit 23/443''' was a local [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Rapid Deployment station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yetnis]] some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ril Garn]], who used it as a staging area for [[Operation: Rebel Hunt]], his attempt to wipe out all [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cells on that world.
